comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

Follow-up on the [earlier review](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13151#issuecomment-5823946839) and the [author's reply](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/13151#issuecomment-5833231165), checked at `7a4a5ad7`.

**Verified:** `7a4a5ad7` fixes the four items the reply lists, with no regression found in the changed lines.

| Earlier point | Status at `7a4a5ad7` | Check |
|---|---|---|
| Quick-failure guard counted the 90 s wait | Resolved | Real 16 s waits, Windows staying `up`: repeated short rc 1 sessions now stop after 3 FreeRDP runs; on `645c002a` the counter reset every time |
| Probe printed connect errors | Resolved | No stderr on `stopped` (was 2 lines per probe); same `stopped`/`up`/`booting` results; no descriptor leak; a `set -e` caller is unaffected |
| Test wrote to the real `$HOME` | Resolved | Outer HOME untouched; the earlier test created `.config/windows/krb5.conf` there |
| rc 11 comment | Resolved | Matches FreeRDP 3.31.1: local close exits 0, 11 is a Disconnect chosen inside Windows |
| Different listener after the container exits; give-up stops the VM; sign-out and takeover reconnect; shutdown and first-boot messages; `userland-proxy: false` | Still present, code unchanged | The reply leaves the listener check, give-up handling and sign-out/takeover exit codes to maintainers; the other two are not changed either |

The updated test passes 9/9 on this head and fails against the `645c002a` launcher at the new stderr assertion.

### The give-up path now covers more cases, and still stops the VM

With the waits no longer counted, two cases that usually reset the counter before now count toward the three-try limit. That limit still breaks into the normal stop block (without `--keep-alive`): "RDP session closed. Stopping Windows VM...", `priv down`, no notification.

Scripted runs (FreeRDP, the probe and `wait_for_rdp_change` stubbed; each wait is a real 16 s sleep):

| Scenario | `645c002a` | `7a4a5ad7` |
|---|---|---|
| rc 1 repeatedly, probe keeps reporting `up` | keeps reconnecting (counter reset each time; ended only by a scripted rc 0 on the 6th run) | 3 FreeRDP runs, then `priv down` |
| first connect fails while `booting`, then fast failures once `up` | 4 runs, then `priv down` | 3 runs, then `priv down` |

With the real `wait_for_rdp_change up 90`, the first case gives up after roughly 5 minutes (from source).

**Impact:** ending the endless rc 1 loop is the intended fix. The earlier "give-up stops the VM with 'RDP session closed'" point now applies to these cases too: the VM stops and nothing tells a `Terminal=false` desktop user that RDP was failing.

**Suggested change:** unchanged from the earlier review. On give-up, leave the VM running and report the failure (terminal and notification), as the 10-minute timeout path does.

**Optional test improvement:** a mutant that restores the old guard (`SECONDS - connected_at`) still passes 9/9. The stubs make every wait take no time, so both formulas give the same result. A scenario in which the post-disconnect wait takes longer than 15 s while the session itself is short would detect it.

**Related open PR:** [#6739](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/pull/6739) ("Keep Windows running when RDP fails") conflicts with this PR at the same `xfreerdp3` exit handling (`git merge-tree`). It returns on every nonzero exit without stopping the VM, and its test expects rc 1 to return status 1 with "RDP connection failed. Windows VM is still running." This PR's test expects rc 1 to reconnect. The two policies need an explicit decision if both are kept.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** follow-up on `7a4a5ad7` against `645c002a`. Source review of `bin/omarchy-windows-vm`, the test, FreeRDP 3.31.1 and GNU bash 5.3 source. Sandboxed runs of the PR test on this head, `645c002a` and two single-line revert mutants, the real `rdp_state` against synthetic listeners in a private network namespace, and the real `launch_windows` loop with scripted FreeRDP exit codes, probe states and waits. No Docker, Windows guest or real FreeRDP connection was used. Points left unchanged were checked for unchanged code only, not re-tested.

**AI process:** Opus 5.5 Medium coordination and synthesis, Opus 5.5 Xhigh technical review and final fact check, GPT 6 Sol Xhigh search for related issues, Opus 5.5 Medium editorial check.
